description: Floor plans for the advert. Mirrors images-schema: only listing_position and title are required, and everything added later is optional. Which CDN generation processed an entry is given by `cdn`: 2 is the legacy Cloudinary path (cloudinary_account / public_id / version), 3 and 4 are Bunny (path). Two shapes occur in live data and both must validate — feed-imported media carries original_url / original_bytes / archived_at, private-vendor media carries none of them because it is uploaded to us directly rather than fetched from a source. See the changelog for why v1.1.0 could not express this, and why v1.2.0's first cut required original_url and was wrong.

title_fr.description: Not currently populated for floor plans. Present so they can adopt the same bilingual treatment as images without another version bump.

original_url.description: The URL the file was collected from. Optional, and absent entirely on private-vendor media: those files are uploaded to us directly, so there is no source URL to record. Feed-imported media carries it.

cdn.description: Which CDN generation holds this file. 2 = Cloudinary (legacy), 3 and 4 = Bunny. Absent until the file has been processed.

path.description: Bunny path, appended to the CDN's base_uri to build a URL (cdn 3 and 4).

cloudinary_account.description: Legacy, cdn 2 only. Retained because IFP\Basebox\AdvertImage\Cdn2AdvertImage still reads it.
